Subject: Re: Demo follow-up / proposed dates

Hi Priya —

Thanks for sending proposed slots. We’ve had a last-minute product launch decision on our side and the core engineering leads (who were going to be on the call) are being pulled into a release week. On top of that, several folks are traveling next week for the launch roadshow.

Apologies for the flip — timing just got away from us.

Mark

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Lumengrid — they pulled the LLM track into launch work (FYI)

Team — quick update: Lumengrid just asked to stand down on the demo. Reason: product launch + travel (engineering heads pulled). They explicitly said they’re moving the LLM/inference initiative into backlog for Q1.

Attachments I sent: agenda PDF + MAP draft. Mark asked for a one-pager and a short checklist of questions we want answered prior to re-engagement. He also asked for a recorded 20-min technical intro (asynchronous).

Questions for you:
- Jordan: can you produce a 1-page capability summary we can tailor to their release constraints (focus on latency/cost predictability and rollout options)? Need by EOD today to send with my note.
- Karthik: any playbook or benchmark we should include that highlights how Redwood handles hot-path launches (burst autoscale / fallbacks)? A short bullet list would be ideal.
- Grace: do we want to offer a limited-time credit or pilot package if they re-engage by end of Q1? If yes, what guardrails (term, usage cap)?

I’ll keep the MAP in HubSpot updated and mark deal RW-DEAL-7832 as nurture.

Thanks — Priya
